defendant: Omega Service Maintenance Corp. et als.
description:
Dimension of Lot Approximately: 100 X 290
Nearest Cross Street: Myrtle Avenue
BEGINNING at a point along the Westerly right of way of fudge avenue (50 feet wide) said point being distant Northerly along said fudge Avenue 30.00 feet from the Northwesterly right of way intersection of said Ridge Avenue with the Northerly right of way of N.J. State Highway Route 33 (width varies) and running; thence
The sale is subject to any all open/unpaid taxes, penalties and interest, municipal taxes, assessments, liens, federal liens, judgments, water and sewer charges, encumbrances, restrictions of record which are unknown at this time and any other changes.
The sale is subject to any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remains of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
The above description does not constitute a full legal description of the property. A full legal description of the property is annexed to that certain Writ of Execution on file with the Office of the Superior Court Clerk, Writ # 25002795.
Plaintiff has advised Sheriff a good faith estimate of the “upset price” on the day of the Sheriff’s sale is not provided due to the property being an industrial/commercial property in nature and not being used as a primary residence. Thus, the Community Wealth Preservation Program is not applicable.
